author: Justin Petrone
title: Made in Estonia with South American soul
quote: … an Estonian South American psychedelic band called Araukaaria …

author: Ana Lešković
title: Kitty Kant Compilation Volume 2: A Review
quote: With its psychedelic and progressive textures, it is reminiscent of Jefferson Airplane, Pink Floyd, and Radiohead.

author: Giulia Galbiati
title: Your Tallinn hit list: the top 5 events this week
quote: Their music blends echoes of Pink Floyd and Radiohead with Sumo and Soda Stereo, layered with Argentine folk and sung in both English and Spanish.

author: Justin Petrone
title: 'canto oscuro' by araukaaria
quote: ‘Canto Oscuro’ is disarmingly sincere. It has a cinematic quality to it — it would make a good backing track to a montage about a religious pilgrimage.

author: Ivo Heinloo
title: DELTA. Külas on Jose Prieto ansamblist Araukaaria
quote: Oma ansambliga Araukaaria esines ta möödunud aastal Tudengijazzil, nüüd on koosseis muutunud, kuid ansambel annab jätkuvalt välja uut muusikat.
translation: He played Tudengijazz with his band Araukaaria last year; the line-up has changed since, but the band keeps releasing new music.

author: Kaspar Viilup
title: Araukaaria: unistame lava jagamisest Vaiko Epliku või Miljarditega
quote: Minu pikaajaline unistus on olnud anda oma emale kätte vinüül oma muusikaga ja nüüd tunnen, et selle unistuse täitumine pole enam kaugel.
translation: My long-held dream has been to hand my mother a vinyl record of my own music, and now I feel that dream is not far from coming true.

author: Justin Petrone
title: soy loco por tí, estonia
quote: The band’s music is informed by South American psychedelia from the 1960s and 1970s, as well as Estonian folk. They have an earnest but passionate sound.

author: Justin Petrone
title: araukaaria, live in viljandi
quote: We will all hear more from Araukaaria. I am sure of it.
